v1_audit.explanation: Validation (2024-02-15…2024-03-14) was a peak dry-season window with positive rate ~6.5% (818/12528), so Brier≈0.058. Holdout mixed Aug 2024 wet season with 2025–2026 windows at positive rate ~0.51% (140/27216), so even a constant seasonal rate has Brier≈p(1−p)≈0.005. The drop is mostly base-rate change, not sudden calibration skill. Skill vs seasonal baseline on holdout was ~0.002. These v1 numbers used flawed empty-FIRMS negatives and must not be promoted as Philippine performance.

cold_square_recall_near_zero.holdout_cold_pr_auc_note: PR-AUC added in v2 training path when negatives exist.
cold_square_recall_near_zero.threshold_selection: Chosen on validation by max F1 only — never on holdout.
cold_square_recall_near_zero.why_cold_recall_approx_0: At the validation-chosen threshold 0.05, Extra Trees fired on recent-heat patterns but almost never crossed 0.05 on cold squares in the sparse holdout (0/138 true positives recovered). Low threshold still yields near-zero cold recall because predicted probabilities for brand-new heat stayed below the cut.
cold_square_recall_near_zero.revision_policy: Holdout was inspected in this audit. Any threshold/model revision after this inspection is recorded as holdout-influenced; reserve new independent Philippine data for the next final evaluation.

holdout_enrichment.note: Recomputed on archived v1 flawed-negative dataset + 11f1861 model for audit only. Not Philippine performance claims under coverage v2.
